title: SelectionChangedParams
description: A selection gesture ended on text the tools can act on, while enabled and showToolbar is on, so native can show its toolbar for it and pick the actions that fit. Sent again when the same text is reselected: native drops repeats. Not sent for selections in a modal dialog, popover or fullscreen element.

text.description: The selected text, without text the user can't see.

editable.description: Whether the selection is in an editable field.

devicePixelRatio.description: The page's window.devicePixelRatio, which includes page zoom.
